issues.message: Unreferenced file: docProps/custom.xml
Unreferenced file: word/numbering.xml
12 <w:p> element(s) lack a w14:paraId. Word stamps one on every paragraph and table row as the anchor for tracked-changes / comment-range infrastructure.
Relationship Id values in word/_rels/document.xml.rels are sequential from rId1 (likely regenerated by the repairer).
